commands.name: sheets.list
commands.description: List the sheets in the open Reckon workbook, e.g. "what sheets are in my spreadsheet".

commands.name: range.read
commands.description: Read the values and formulas in a range of the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "what is in A1 to C10 on Sheet1".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of at most 2,000 cells, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"

commands.name: range.write
commands.description: Write values or formulas into the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "put 42 in B2 on Sheet1".

ref.description: Sheet name and top-left cell, e.g. "Sheet1!B2"

values.description: Rows of cells, e.g. [[1, 2], [3, "=A1+B1"]]. Text that starts with = is a formula; null clears the cell.

commands.name: formula.eval
commands.description: Work out a formula without changing the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "what is the sum of A1 to A9 on Sheet1".

sheet.description: The sheet its cell references read from, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: recalc
commands.description: Recompute every formula in the Reckon workbook, e.g. "recalculate my spreadsheet".
